family: 行业中性 / 行业轮动 / 行业分层归因
conclusion: 历史上不可做：本地行业归属只有 2026-11-01~06 的 6 个时点快照（面板内 5 个交易日，0.23%），另有一份无日期列的当前快照与一份无日期维度的产业链图谱；财务表无主营构成字段，因此没有任何无前视的历史行业归属来源。预计算行业联动因子在 9,752,990 行历史中非空数为 0。唯一合规的可用切片是 2026-11-02~06 五天的当日截面行业相对强弱，不具有跨期检验价值。另已排查唯一候选捷径 mainline_history 的 industry 维度（2018-01-10 起 6,476 行）：它是用当前行业快照回看历史聚合涨停梯队得到的，代码自带前视声明，且只覆盖涨停事件、不含全样本个股归属，否决。
partial_capability: 2026-11-02~06 共 5 个交易日可做当日截面行业相对强弱（无前视）；无法做行业中性化回测或行业轮动

facts.name: 行业时点快照分区（ext_hy_ths_pit）
facts.note: 目录列举：date=* 分区即一次快照；文件为零字节即为空分区

facts.name: 每个快照日的证券数与行业标签数
facts.sql: select date::varchar as snapshot_date, count(*) as n_rows, count(distinct symbol) as n_symbols, count(distinct "所属同花顺行业") as n_industries, count(*) filter (where "所属同花顺行业" is null or trim("所属同花顺行业") = '') as n_null_industry from read_parquet('D:/TSP/data/ext_data/ext_hy_ths_pit/timeseries/**/*.parquet', hive_partitioning=true) group by 1 order by 1

facts.name: 行业快照与面板交易日对齐
facts.sql: select (select count(*) from panel_dates) as panel_trading_days, (select count(*) from panel_dates pd where exists (select 1 from (select distinct date from read_parquet('D:/TSP/data/ext_data/ext_hy_ths_pit/timeseries/**/*.parquet', hive_partitioning=true)) p where p.date = pd.date)) as panel_days_with_same_day_industry

facts.name: 窗口内每个交易日有行业标签的证券数（5 个交易日）
facts.note: 每个交易日一条 SQL，全部逐条记入 sql_log：select count(distinct symbol) from read_parquet(pit_file) 与 kline 分区按 symbol join 计数

facts.name: 全期（含窗口）行业标签对面板的覆盖
facts.sql: select (select count(*) from panel_agg) as panel_symbols, (select count(distinct symbol) from read_parquet('D:/TSP/data/ext_data/ext_hy_ths_pit/timeseries/**/*.parquet', hive_partitioning=true)) as snapshot_union_symbols, (select count(*) from panel_agg where symbol in (select distinct symbol from read_parquet('D:/TSP/data/ext_data/ext_hy_ths_pit/timeseries/**/*.parquet', hive_partitioning=true))) as panel_symbols_labeled_ever, (select count(*) from panel_agg where symbol not in (select distinct symbol from read_parquet('D:/TSP/data/ext_data/ext_hy_ths_pit/timeseries/**/*.parquet', hive_partitioning=true))) as panel_symbols_never_labeled

facts.name: 非时点行业快照（ext_hy_ths）
facts.sql: select count(*) as n_rows, count(distinct symbol) as n_symbols from read_parquet('D:/TSP/data/ext_data/ext_hy_ths/part.parquet')
facts.note: snapshot 模式：无日期列，只能代表 '当前'，不能当作历史

facts.name: 预计算的行业联动因子（kline_daily_linkage）非空率
facts.sql: select count(*) as total_rows, count(industry_relative_momentum_20d) as nonnull_industry_relative_momentum_20d, count(industry_rank_momentum_20d) as nonnull_industry_rank_momentum_20d, count(industry_corr_60d) as nonnull_industry_corr_60d, count(industry_beta_60d) as nonnull_industry_beta_60d, count(distinct date) as dates, min(date) as first_date, max(date) as last_date from read_parquet('D:/TSP/data/kline_daily_linkage/**/*.parquet')

facts.name: 含任一非空行业因子的分区数
facts.sql: select count(*) as partitions, sum(case when n > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as partitions_with_any_industry_factor from (select date, count(industry_relative_momentum_20d) as n from read_parquet('D:/TSP/data/kline_daily_linkage/**/*.parquet') group by 1)
